title: ChatGPT launches new personal finance experience with AI-powered money management
summary: ChatGPT introduces a new personal finance experience helping users with budget planning, expense tracking, and financial decisions powered by GPT-5.5.

title: Grok 4.3 launches with 1M token context and 4 reasoning effort levels
summary: xAI launches Grok 4.3 as the fastest and most intelligent Grok model with 1 million token context window, priced at $1.25/1M input and $2.50/1M output tokens.

title: MiniMax Hailuo 02 launches with record-breaking cost efficiency for video generation
summary: MiniMax Hailuo 02 launches with Noise-aware Compute Redistribution architecture achieving 2.5x training efficiency. Ranks second globally on Artificial Analysis Video Arena with native 1080p generation.

title: MiniMax M2.1 post-training insights released with Agent model best practices
summary: MiniMax M2.1 post-training experience and insights document reveals agent model development learnings. M2.1 ranks #1 among open-source models on Hot Arena leaderboard.

title: Anthropic launches Claude for Small Business with connectors for QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot
summary: Claude for Small Business launches as a toggle install putting AI to work inside tools small businesses depend on: Intuit Quickbooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365.

title: NVIDIA Hermes unlocks self-improving AI agents powered by Qwen 3.6 on RTX PCs and DGX Spark
summary: NVIDIA Hermes launches as a self-improving AI agent running on local RTX PCs and DGX Spark, powered by Qwen 3.6 models that match 400B model accuracy at 1/16th the size.

title: NVIDIA and SAP Bring Trust to Specialized Agents with OpenShell integration
summary: NVIDIA and SAP announce expanded collaboration at SAP Sapphire to help enterprises run specialized agents with security and governance controls through OpenShell open-source runtime.

title: xAI launches Grok Build early beta for terminal-based coding agents
summary: Grok Build launches in early beta for SuperGrok Heavy subscribers as a new coding agent that runs directly from the terminal.

title: xAI retiring grok-3, grok-4 series models May 15 with redirect to grok-4.3
summary: xAI retiring grok-3, grok-4-fast, grok-4-1-fast, grok-4-0709, grok-code-fast-1, and grok-imagine-image-pro on May 15. All redirect to grok-4.3 with updated pricing.

title: OpenAI launches dedicated Codex Chrome extension for browser AI workflows
summary: OpenAI launches a dedicated Chrome extension for Codex, enabling AI-powered browser workflows and web automation directly from the browser.

title: Anthropic and PwC expand alliance to deploy Claude for technology build and enterprise reinvention
summary: Anthropic and PwC expand strategic alliance to use Claude to build technology, execute deals, and reinvent enterprise functions globally. Claude already running in production across sports operations, insurance underwriting, and mainframe modernization.

title: Google DeepMind reimagines the mouse pointer with AI interaction research
summary: Google DeepMind publishes research on shaping the future of AI interaction by reimagining the mouse pointer, exploring new paradigms for human-AI interface design.

title: Google DeepMind AlphaEvolve coding agent scales impact across scientific fields
summary: AlphaEvolve, Google's Gemini-powered coding agent, demonstrates success in accelerating mathematical and scientific discovery, enhancing data center efficiency, chip design, and AI training processes.

title: xAI launches Grok Connectors for deep integrations across web, iOS, and Android
summary: xAI launches Grok Connectors bringing deep integrations that bring the apps users use every day directly into Grok, expanding the assistant's capabilities across platforms.

title: SpaceXAI signs agreement with Anthropic to provide access to Colossus 1 supercomputer
summary: SpaceXAI signs agreement with Anthropic to provide access to Colossus 1, one of the world's largest AI supercomputers with over 220,000 NVIDIA GPUs. Partnership includes plans to develop multiple gigawatts of orbital AI capacity.

title: xAI launches Grok Imagine Quality Mode API for higher realism and better text rendering
summary: Grok Imagine Quality Mode API launches with higher realism, stronger text rendering, and better creative control for enterprise developers and teams.

title: Mistral Medium 3.5 launches with remote coding agents in Vibe
summary: Mistral Medium 3.5 launches as a frontier-class multimodal model optimized for agentic and coding use cases. Remote coding agents run in cloud sandboxes and can autonomously open pull requests when tasks complete.

title: OpenAI launches three realtime voice models: GPT-Realtime-2, Translate, and Whisper
summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-Realtime-2 with GPT-5-class reasoning for voice interactions, GPT-Realtime-Translate supporting 70+ languages, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper for low-latency streaming transcription.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 launches as Anthropic's most capable generally available model
summary: Claude Opus 4.7 launches with 13% resolution improvement over Opus 4.6 on coding benchmarks, enhanced vision supporting 2,576 pixel images, and new xhigh effort level for complex agentic tasks.

title: Anthropic Claude Code introduces UltraReview slash command for comprehensive code review
summary: Anthropic Claude Code introduces /ultrareview command that reads through code changes and flags bugs and design issues. Pro and Max users get three free ultrareviews to start.

title: NVIDIA and Corning announce long-term partnership to strengthen US manufacturing for AI infrastructure
summary: NVIDIA and Corning announce multiyear partnership to expand US-based manufacturing of advanced optical connectivity solutions. Corning will increase optical connectivity manufacturing capacity 10x and create 3,000+ jobs.

title: NVIDIA names Suzanne Nora Johnson to Board of Directors
summary: NVIDIA announces appointment of Suzanne Nora Johnson to its Board of Directors, bringing extensive financial and technology industry expertise to the company.

title: NVIDIA and IREN announce strategic partnership to accelerate deployment of up to 5 gigawatts of AI infrastructure
summary: NVIDIA and IREN announce strategic partnership to accelerate deployment of up to 5 gigawatts of AI infrastructure, marking another major investment in AI data center capacity.

title: Anthropic launches agents for financial services with ten ready-to-run templates
summary: Anthropic releases ten ready-to-run agent templates for financial services: building pitchbooks, screening KYC files, and closing the books at month-end. Claude Opus 4.7 leads industry on Vals AI Finance Agent benchmark at 64.37%.
